content.title: Why Analysts See Kroger’s Story Shifting With New Delivery Deals And Data Driven Growth
content.summary: Kroger's stock narrative is shifting as analysts slightly trim their fair value estimate to about $74.36 while nudging up both the discount rate and long term revenue growth outlook.
